scripts.typecheck: pnpm build && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.tests.json && pnpm -r --filter "./examples/**" run typecheck
scripts.test:e2e: pnpm build && pnpm --filter @janitor/example-node build && pnpm --filter @janitor/example-node exec esbuild ../../tests/e2e/analytics-client.ts --bundle --format=esm --outfile=../../artifacts/analytics/client.js && playwright test
scripts.protocol:sync: pnpm build && tsx scripts/sync-protocol.ts && pnpm --filter @janitor/example-node exec esbuild ../../packages/browser/src/index.ts --bundle --format=esm --minify --outfile=../../packages/elixir/priv/static/janitor.js
scripts.benchmark:connections:build: pnpm build && pnpm --filter @janitor/example-node exec esbuild ../../scripts/benchmarks/connections-server.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --external:pg-native --banner:js='import { createRequire } from "node:module"; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);' --outfile=../../artifacts/benchmarks/server.mjs && pnpm --filter @janitor/example-node exec esbuild ../../scripts/benchmarks/connections-client.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=../../artifacts/benchmarks/client.mjs
